title: Overnight Oats with Berries
description: Assembled in two minutes the night before, eaten cold out of the jar.
steps: Stir the oats, milk, skyr, chia seeds, honey and salt together in a jar until there are no dry pockets left.
Tip the frozen berries on top — they thaw overnight and bleed into the oats.

steps.text: Lid on, fridge, at least six hours.
